name: Vamshi Rubber Limited
summary: Vamshi Rubber Limited specializes in the production and distribution of precured tread rubber and associated materials. Their comprehensive range of offerings includes precured tread rubber, cushion gum, waste hauler lug, curing envelopes, and vulcanizing solutions, all of which are crucial for the reconditioning of used tires. Established on November 24, 1993, the company maintains its principal office in Hyderabad, India.
